title: Cake Cookie Clap
hook: Clap after the name; let the structure speak first.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: colorful 3D cakes-and-cookies storybook, playful icing colors, simple serving table, clear single-item foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: geometry cue -> recall beat -> target -> air-shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a clap-stop followed by a tiny glockenspiel pastry-case sparkle.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a clap-stop followed by a tiny glockenspiel pastry-case sparkle
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Cake Cookie Clap a structural geometry song: crumb, shell, layer, grid, knot, roll, stripe and coating are compared from cross-sections rather than ranking sweetness.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child looks at silhouettes and cut surfaces, then claps only between target reveals so structure stays audible.
